test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
Which figure will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7eb54a4e594032866ac8d4eb15ce9305f8c7d2965f15141dc2701ec7c9e3b226.png]
solution:
Here, the following pattern is followed. There is **an addition of arrow** in every next stage of the figure and the arrows change its direction,** firstly clockwise and** **then anti - clockwise.**

So, the figure will have 5 arrows and moving in a clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da107c49aa4af42d4bad307f518533747eb754fc4b300436812ad1121ba43f2f.png] 

Only option(3) has 5 arrows and that to moving in a clockwise. 

Hence, the correct answer is** option(3)**
